header:
Fundamentals of Organic Chemistry
The rates and selectivities of organic reactions depend not only on electronic structure but also strongly on molecular conformation and spatial arrangement in the transition state.

8.1.2 Under identical reaction conditions, substrate structure affects the rate of epoxidation. Arrange the following compounds in decreasing order of reaction rate.
